story: Create Account Button Disabled for Incomplete Form
description: Verifies that the 'Create My Account' button remains disabled when form fields are incomplete or terms not agreed.

story: Create Account Button Enabled for Valid Form
description: Verifies that filling valid registration data and checking Terms & Conditions enables the Create My Account button.

story: Full End-to-End Registration & OTP Verification Flow
description: Verifies complete end-to-end registration flow: Navigate to Sign Up, fill details, accept terms, tap Create Account, enter 123456 OTP, tap Verify, and verify 'Account Created Successfully!' screen.
